instruction.text: Fill in the gaps in this conversation between two Athenian women and answer the questions.

atoms.b: Theokleia, have you heard about Herais? Now that she’s ((++married mummified)) to a rich man, I don’t know when we will see her again.
I don’t think we will. She has enslaved ((++people pets)) do everything for her.
It must be lonely. Our ((++husbands demigods)) might not be rich, but at least we see each other when we fetch water or buy ((++food video_games)).
True ... but none of us women have much freedom. We can’t own property, ((++vote marry)) or even speak with ((++men women)) outside our family.
Our world is the home: cooking, weaving and ((++children weaponry)). That’s just how life is in Athens.

atoms.a: Which of the following were women in Athens not allowed to do?
What were the main duties of Athenian women?

instruction.text: Read the text and answer the question.

atoms.text: Sparta granted women more freedom than Athens, allowing them to own property, do sports and receive some education.
When Spartan men went to war, women took charge of households and farms, gaining more control over their daily lives.

atoms.a: Which of the following freedoms did Spartan women have? Select all correct answers.

atoms.b: Some very special women were able to gain influence and ((++rights wrongs)) as oracles.
Oracles were believed to communicate with the ((++gods cyborgs)) and reveal the future. They were even ((++consulted ignored)) on military and political decisions!

instruction.text: Sort the women of ancient Greece based on their freedoms and influence. Start with the most influential at the top.
